evals.prompt: My party is exploring the ruins of an old elven tower in chapter 2. Generate a location for it.
evals.expected_output: A written draft at campaigns/<active-campaign>/_drafts/location/<slug>.md with elven-tower-themed content, populated challenges/secrets/plot_hooks/npcs/environmental_features tied to the ruins setting, and all required frontmatter keys.

assertions.name: valid_frontmatter
assertions.description: Frontmatter includes layout, title, permalink, category, chapter, episode, scene, jumbo, thumb, portrait, tags, search, excerpt_separator, id, slug, name, type, description

assertions.name: no_stray_body
assertions.description: The draft's Markdown body is empty - all content lives in frontmatter

evals.prompt: Generate a location for my campaign.
evals.expected_output: No active campaign is set, so the skill reports the no_active_campaign error and tells the user to run scripts/use-campaign first, without writing any draft.

assertions.name: no_draft_written
assertions.description: No file is created under any campaigns/*/_drafts/location/

assertions.name: clear_error
assertions.description: Response tells the user to run scripts/use-campaign, matching the no_active_campaign error message

evals.prompt: Generate a hidden temple for the party to discover, no other details given.
evals.expected_output: No party level is mentioned, so the skill assumes a level 5 party, says so in its response, and still generates and writes a complete draft without blocking on a clarifying question.

assertions.name: states_assumption
assertions.description: Response explicitly states it assumed a level 5 party

assertions.name: no_blocking_question
assertions.description: The skill does not stop to ask the user for party level before generating

assertions.name: draft_written
assertions.description: A location draft is still written despite no level being given
